reviews.name: Samah A.
reviews.text:
Mehreen was truly a necessity for our wedding. With over 900 guests, things had to run smoothly—and thanks to her and her amazing team, they absolutely did. She was constantly thinking of everything, even the little details we would’ve never thought of, and made sure everything flowed perfectly. Not only did she work well with our families but she coordinated exceptionally with our vendors as well and that allowed me and husband’s families to truly enjoy our wedding day.

She gave me the best tips and tricks throughout the process and made sure every single thing we wanted happened. On top of all that, she was so sweet and supportive—always there to calm my nerves and just be a reassuring presence.

Honestly, she was a beast in the best way—organized, on top of it all, and totally in control. We couldn’t recommend her more. If you want someone who truly has your back and knows how to bring your vision to life, Mehreen’s your person.

reviews.name: Nicole W.
reviews.text:
I cannot thank Mehreen and her staff enough. My wedding was absolute perfection and it is all thanks to Miraj Events. Everything from planning, decorating, coordinating, day of assisting was done effortlessly. I do not know what I would have done without her or her staff. I felt so taken care of, and did not have a single worry the day of my wedding. As chaotic as weddings can be, she and her staff made everything seamless, from organizing all of my decorations after the wedding for me to take home, and ensuring I was comfortable every step of the way.

I cannot recommend Miraj events enough, her organization and impeccable staff is truly what made my special day so amazing.

reviews.name: Fatima S.
reviews.role: Mother of the groom · six months of planning
reviews.text:
I worked with Mehreen for 6 months this year starting almost the same week we started planning for my son’s wedding. I knew I couldn’t do it on my own, with a full time job and lots of responsibilities. What made it even harder was the quick turnaround this wedding needed to be planned in and from day one I was already worried that venues and vendors would already be booked. In walked Mehreen and became my sanity in between all the wedding planning craziness!! She sat down with me to start understanding my needs, my budget and my overall feeling and vibe of the wedding I was trying to accomplish. For such a large number of invitees and many different requirements, she helped me narrow down the venue to two specific ones. We did walk throughs of both and made our decision. That was maybe the only time I needed to physically go somewhere and see someone, the rest of the times I trusted her and her decision making for her to do all the heavy grunt work.

Mehreen helped me in determining and securing every vendor from that point onwards, every time letting me know pricing and pros and cons of each one, which made my decision-making seamless. All decisions and budget items were recorded on spreadsheets and helped me in my planning process in the six months.

There were several events/moments to coordinate. Not just the wedding and Mehreen helped me with every single one. She kept me on time with her timeline, let me know when and what the next step was, and continued to scope out and research vendors and technology platforms that would help us with the wedding. For example, she helped me to figure out which invitation platform to use and what website to use to create a seating chart. Mehreen also learned and understood my needs so well that she’d tell me her honest opinions on vendors and pricing. She never made it seem like she was trying to push me to do or pay for a certain thing. I rarely had to speak directly to a vendor myself. She even dealt with the negotiating of prices and drawing up the contracts. This made my life much much easier!!!!

She came over several times to help with the big and small details and had her team help where they needed so much so it was as if she became a part of our family! :) On the day of the event, my only stress was to get me and my family to the hall on time, because I knew she had taken care of planning every single corner of the venue and every single minute of the evening. What struck me about her most is her even-keeled nature, composure, and calm stature. In the most stressful of situations she’d laugh and say don’t worry. Everything will be fine. And then would offer solutions to make everything fine! This in turn calmed everyone else around her also…and that’s invaluable to have someone like that around!!

I wouldn’t just use Mehreen again when planning a wedding, I now go around and recommend her to everyone I know! Highly recommend her and her team and her expertise.

reviews.name: Aliya Z.
reviews.text:
I truly don't know how we would have pulled off our son's engagement party without Mehreen Buksh. From the very first conversation, it was clear we were in the best possible hands. Every single detail was handled with such care and precision: the caterers, the venue, the photographer, the florist, the DJ, all coordinated seamlessly, like clockwork. Nothing fell through the cracks, and nothing felt rushed or chaotic.

What stood out most was how pleasant and genuinely helpful Mehreen was at every single step. No question was too small, no request too much trouble. She anticipated things we hadn't even thought to ask about and handled them before they could become problems. Our vendors all worked together beautifully, and I have no doubt that's a direct result of how organized and communicative Mehreen was throughout the entire process.

We got to actually enjoy our engagement; present, relaxed, and soaking in every moment instead of stressing over logistics.

Mehreen Buksh is the person you want in your corner. Thank you for making our celebration everything we dreamed of and more!

reviews.name: Juan A.
reviews.text: As a wedding vendor it always helps having the support and organization of a planner. The day just goes by so smoothly and makes work a breeze on the wedding day. Miraj Events was so helpful on the wedding day, keeping me informed along any changes or important moments that were about to take place. The team was amazing. I would love to work with her again.

reviews.name: PhotosBy Mahin
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of working with Mehreen as the wedding photographer for a recent event, and I can confidently say that she was instrumental in making the entire day seamless. From the moment I arrived, it was clear that every detail had been meticulously planned and organized. Mehreen’s professionalism, attention to detail, and calm demeanor were evident throughout the day.

She ensured that the schedule flowed perfectly, which not only made my job as a photographer easier but also allowed the couple and their guests to enjoy every moment without stress. Mehreen’s ability to anticipate needs and solve potential issues before they even arose was impressive. She communicated effectively with everyone involved, from the couple to the vendors, and created an environment that was both organized and relaxed.

If you’re looking for a wedding planner who will go above and beyond to make your day perfect, Mehreen is the one to trust. Highly recommend her for her expertise, creativity, and genuine care for her clients.
